s.p.espaces.rg_d: Zvinhu zvekunze, zviyero zvezvinhu, kuvhura bhizinesi, mapuratifomu ekudyara: zvinopihwa zvepamutemo zvenyika.
s.p.espaces.rg_sub: Mitemo inochinja nguva dzose: ONE WORLD haina kurodha pasi, inovhura zvinyorwa zvepamutemo zvakagadziridzwa, uye iwe unoverenga mutauro wako.
s.p.espaces.rg_g1: Global Trade Helpdesk (ITC, UNCTAD, WTO): yechigadzirwa uye nyika, mitero, zvikwereti, mitemo nematanho pane imwe peji
s.p.espaces.rg_g2: Market Access Map (ITC): mitero yekumadokero uye mitemo yekutanga
s.p.espaces.rg_g3: ePing (WTO): zvinodiwa, zvinyorwa zvezvigadzirwa uye mitemo yezvehutano iyi nyika inodaira zvigadzirwa
s.p.espaces.rg_e1: Access2Markets: kutengesa neEU uye kubva kuEU, danho nedanho
s.p.espaces.rg_e2: TARIC: code yekumadokero uye mitero yekupinda muEU
s.p.espaces.rg_b1: Business Ready (World Bank): kuvhura bhizinesi, zvikwereti, zvekunze, nyika nenyika
s.p.espaces.rg_i1: I-SCAN (IOSCO): tarisa kuti chikuva hachina kuratidzwa nemutemo usati wazvivimba nemari
s.p.espaces.rg_note: Iyo saiti inovhura mutauro wayo wega: shandisa kushandura kwebrowser yako, kana « Kunzwisisa dhata » yedhata. Kuti uite sarudzo huru, taura nemunhu ane ruzivo rwekutaura mutauro uyu.
s.p.espaces.cu_d: Zvikwereti, mapepa, Incoterms, zviwanikwa zvemahara zvehurumende, vanotakura zvinhu uye vafambi.
s.p.espaces.cu_sub: 24/24 ONE WORLD haisi kuisa zvinyorwa zvekutengeserana: mutengesi ane chitupa chekutengeserana (freight forwarder) anogona kuita izvi kwauri.
s.p.espaces.cu_t1: Market Access Map (ITC, UN-WTO): mabasa uye mitemo yeanopfuura ese nyika
s.p.espaces.cu_t2: Access2Markets (European Union): mitero, zvikwereti, mitemo yemunharaunda, nhanho nenzira
s.p.espaces.cu_t3: TARIC: code yekunze (HS code) uye mitero yekupinda muEuropean Union
s.p.espaces.cu_d3: Kutakura mufananidzo: kutakura zvinhu (sea), air waybill (air), CMR (road)
s.p.espaces.cu_d5: EORI nhamba (zvemabhizimusi anotengesa kana kutumira kunze kwenyika muEU)
s.p.espaces.cu_d6: Zvinoenderana nechigadzirwa: chitupa chehutano kana phytosanitary, rezinesi, CE standards
s.p.espaces.cu_i1: EXW: mutengesi anodzora zvese kubva kufekitori yemutengesi.
s.p.espaces.cu_i2: FCA: Mutengesi anopa zvinhu zvakagadziriswa zvekunze kune mutengi's carrier.
s.p.espaces.cu_i3: FOB: Mutengesi anotakura zvinhu pachikepe; mushure meizvozvo, zvikonzero uye mari ndeyemutengi.
s.p.espaces.cu_i4: CIF: Mutengesi anobhadhara mari yekutakura uye kubhadhara chikwereti kusvika pakusvika kwechikepe.
s.p.espaces.cu_i5: DAP: Mutengesi anopa kunzvimbo yekutumira, mutengi anobhadhara mitero yekufambisa.
s.p.espaces.cu_i6: DDP: Mutengesi anobhadhara zvese, kusanganisira mitero yekufambisa.
s.p.espaces.cu_ban: Kurambidzwa kana kudzorwa panzvimbo dzose: mishonga, majekiseni, zvisiri pamutemo, zvisikwa zvinodzivirirwa (CITES), zvimwe zvezvirwere.
s.p.espaces.cu_src: Izvo: ICC (Incoterms 2020), ITC, European Commission, douane.gouv.fr. Ndokumbira utarise zvakajeka zvinodiwa zvezvigadzirwa zvako.

s.p.espaces.mt_d: Western Union, MoneyGram, Wise, Remitly... sanganisa mari yenyika yako usati watumira.

s.p.espaces.mt_k1: Tarisa mari yawakawana: mitero + mutengo wemari.Mutengo wakaipa kupfuura mutengo wemusika unoreva kuti pane chikwereti chakaipisisa.
s.p.espaces.mt_k2: Choose sei munhu anowana: mari, akaunti yebhangi kana mobile wallet (M-Pesa, Orange Money, MTN...).
s.p.espaces.mt_k3: Mumwe munhu anodawo kuratidza zita rake kuti akwanise kutumira kana kugamuchira mari.
s.p.espaces.mt_k4: Usatumira mari kuna munhu wawakasangana naye paInternet chete, kana kuti "kuvhura" mubairo, chipo, mari yekudyara kana visa: zvinongoita sezviri kuitika nguva dzose.
s.p.espaces.mt_note: Masevhisi uye mutengo unochinja: tarisa pawebhusaiti yavo nguva dzose paunenge uchitumira.
s.p.espaces.ds_d: Kutengesa pasina stock: tsvaga mutengesi, gadzirisa mutengo wakajeka, ugare mukati memutemo.
s.p.espaces.ds_sub: Dropshipping zvinoreva kutengesa chigadzirwa icho mutengesi anotumira zvakananga kune mutengi wako. Zvakanaka kutanga, asi iwe unoramba uine basa rekutengesa.
s.p.espaces.ds_s1: Choose chigadzirwa chinobvumidzwa munyika yevatengi vako: hapana zvinodhaka, hapana zvigadzirwa zvakachengeteka pasina mvumo.
s.p.espaces.ds_s2: Dzvanya pano kuti uwane mutengesi ("Wholesale / supplier" zvinyorwa here kana wholesale platforms) uye utore saizi yemufananidzo usati watenga.
s.p.espaces.ds_s3: Kushanda kunze kwechokwadi mutengo: chigadzirwa, kutumira, mitero yekunze, VAT yenyika yemushandisi, kubhadhara mari uye kudzoka.
s.p.espaces.ds_s4: Ita shuwa kuti unoudza vatengi vako nguva chaiyo yekutumira.
s.p.espaces.ds_s5: Rekodha bhizinesi rako: zita rekambani, VAT uye mitero zvichienderana nenyika yako (ona mitemo yezvekutengesa).
s.p.espaces.ds_s6: Kuremekedza kodzero dzevatengi: mutengo wakajeka, kusanganisira zvikwereti, kodzero yekudzoka, chengetedzo, kuchengetedzwa kwedata.
s.p.espaces.ds_w1: Mutengesi anoda kubhadharwa kwemari yose nekutumira mari kunze kwenyika kana mu cryptocurrency.
s.p.espaces.ds_w2: Yakabhadharwa kudzidza izvo zvinotarisirwa kuita kuti iwe uwane mari nekukurumidza.
s.p.espaces.ds_w3: Kutengeswa kwemapikicha uye zvisirizvo zvinoongororwa: zvakarambidzwa uye zvinopesana.
s.p.espaces.ds_w4: MuEuropean Union, chipo kubva kunze kweEU chinobhadhara VAT kubva pakutanga euro.
